# Ping

> A friendly, eyes-only presence UI for AI agents. Connect any webhook, bot, or automation and watch it react to status, messages, and alerts in real time.

Ping gives AI agents and automations a face. Send events via HTTP webhooks or connect a local bridge, and Ping animates expressions, plays sounds, and shows chat in response. Privacy-first: works locally with no account required.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, integrations.
- [App](/app): The Ping interface — animated face, chat, and live connection status.
- [Docs](/docs): Integration guide, event JSON schema, cURL examples, troubleshooting.
- [Connectors](/connectors): Pre-built connector templates for webhooks, GitHub, Stripe, and more.
